at://did:plc:k6mx56jnfk2bbp4xqzvg7ezs/ap.text: I genuinely think some of the best video game experiences aren't the ones with the best graphics or combat. They're the ones that leave you thinking about the story weeks later.

at://did:plc:cxfbdjieaifiy2iy6fofeapf/ap.text: There's a actual story you don't have to find! Dungeons are fun and interesting! Side quests are giving you actual rewards! It's stuff that might not seem major these days as it's been like 20-30 years now but back then there's a reason this was called the best game of all time.
